title: Bring your need like a child
summary: Need does not disqualify you from the path. It becomes part of the prayer.
takeaway: You do not have to become self-sufficient before seeking Guru.
lifeApplication: Pray with plain need today instead of polished language.

source.shortMeaning: The Guru is named as protector, mother, and father.
source.lifeApplication: Bring loneliness and dependence into prayer without embarrassment.

evidence.coreClaim: The Guru is named as protector, mother, and father.
evidence.turn: Neediness is not rejected here. It is brought honestly into the Guru's care.
evidence.practicalImplication: Pray with plain need today instead of polished language.
